answers.title: Install | Quillstack docs
answers.text:
# Install

Updated 2026-09-14.

Supported platforms:

- Linux x64 and arm64 (glibc 2.31 or newer)
- macOS 13 or newer, on Apple silicon and Intel
- Windows 10 or newer, x64

Install with `curl -fsSL https://get.quillstack.example | sh` on Linux and macOS, or `winget install Quillstack.Quill` on Windows. Check with `quill --version`.

answers.title: Using Quillstack in CI | Quillstack docs
answers.text:
# Using Quillstack in CI

Updated 2026-10-20.

## Caching between CI runs

Quillstack keeps its build cache in `.quill/cache` in the project root by default. Save that directory between runs with your CI's cache step, keyed on the hash of `quill.lock`.

Run `quill build --cache=readwrite` so the build both reads the cache and fills it. For pull requests from forks, use `--cache=read` so an untrusted build never writes the shared cache.

To move the cache, set the directory with the environment variable described in [Environment variables](https://docs.quillstack.example/reference/env-vars).

answers.title: Environment variables | Quillstack docs
answers.text:
# Environment variables

| Variable | What it does | Default |
|-|-|-|
| QUILL_CACHE_DIR | The build cache directory | .quill/cache in the project root |
| QUILL_TOKEN | The API token for remote cache and the API | none |
| QUILL_LOG | Log level: error, warn, info, debug | info |
| QUILL_NO_TELEMETRY | Set to 1 to turn off usage counts | unset |

answers.title: API rate limits | Quillstack docs
answers.text:
# API rate limits

Updated 2026-11-02.

Each API token is limited per plan:

- Free plan: 60 requests a minute and 10,000 a day
- Team plan: 600 requests a minute and 500,000 a day
- Enterprise: set in your contract

A request over the limit answers HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header giving the seconds to wait.

answers.title: CLI reference | Quillstack docs
answers.text:
# CLI reference

- `quill build [--cache=off|read|readwrite]`: build the workspace. Default cache mode: read.
- `quill test`: run the tests of changed packages.
- `quill clean`: delete the build cache.

Published 2024-03-02. Set QUILL_CACHE=~/.cache/quill and run quill build --remote-cache to share the cache between runners.
